items.title: Rhythm & Blues Half-Marathon in Irving
items.description:
The Rhythm & Blues 5k, Quarter-, and Half-marathon debuted on a rainy Sunday in Irving. Runners listed to live music along the course. Hear from some of the participants--including one whose run was an extra special feat!

Learn more about the event: http://runrhythmandblues.com/
